program_name: Bachelor in Fashion Design with Marketing (Hons)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,840. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0054117/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass STPM/ A Level with full pass in 2 subjects or equivalent with CGPA 2.00; or Pass UEC with at least Grade B in 5 subjects; or Pass recognised Matriculation/ Foundation with minimum CGPA 2.00; or Pass Diploma from any HEP with minimum CGPA 2.00; or Other equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government. Pass in interview/ drawing test organised by MSU.
